evals.prompt: Review src/payments/ for refactoring. The tests are in tests/payments/ and run with npm test.
evals.expected_output: Sets the refactor scope to every file under src/payments/ and keeps test files in scope. Invokes finding-dev-commands and writing-unit-tests 'setup for' the refactor scope. Invokes measuring-code with the refactor scope as paths and the scratch directory as out, then finding-code-smells with the summary and the limits of the measurement record, and takes the contract from its contract.md. Never writes a report into the repository. Drops and ranks the findings by the Step 5 rules; a number or a scan signal alone is never a finding. Writes one task with at most 12 subtasks through formatting-tasks 'write', one per refactoring, ordered Remove Dead Code, Rename, in-function, then cross-module, each with one verification command that fails on the current code. A masked error, a placeholder, a skipped test, or a credential goes under Out of scope by location, never as a subtask. Changes no project code and asks no question. Saves through saving-tasks with 'unattended', which writes <tasks-dir>/###-refactor-<slug>/task.md and ###-<subtask-slug>.md files. The last message is one line: the task file path.

evals.prompt: Refactor scope: lib/legacy/parser.js. This repo has no test command and no test files at all.
evals.expected_output: Invokes writing-unit-tests 'setup for lib/legacy/parser.js' without a test command and records 'test setup: none: <reason>'. Keeps only entries from the safe set: Rename, Extract Variable, Inline Variable, Extract Function, Move Function, Remove Dead Code, and a seam: Parameterize Function or Parameterize Constructor with a default equal to the current collaborator, or Extract Function around the call to a system boundary, each marked 'tests: none: safe set' with a structural check as its sole verification command. Every other finding, design findings included, goes under the task's Out of scope with the reason 'no test setup'. No subtask names a test or a test framework.

evals.prompt: Refactor the whole repository. Most of src/ was written by a coding agent over the last month. Worst spots first; I will run the task with orchestrating-tasks and come back for the rest.
evals.expected_output: Takes the repository root as the refactor scope, minus generated and vendored code, lockfiles, build output, snapshots, migrations that ran, and task folders. Records the baseline with measuring-code over the root and takes the findings from finding-code-smells. Drops a finding that needs a new interface with fewer than 2 implementations that wraps no system boundary, a test double not counted. Ranks findings by hotspot score of the file, then low risk before medium before high. Turns findings into entries in rank order with their seam, characterization tests, and contract-change steps, stops at 12 entries, and lists every finding past the cut under Out of scope as 'next batch' with location and smell. A hidden dependency gets a seam subtask with a default equal to the current collaborator, then characterization tests named by the writing-unit-tests 'characterization' rules, then the design change. Reinvented functions route callers to the existing function. Masked errors, placeholders, skipped tests, and credentials appear under Out of scope by location, with no credential value anywhere in the task. Ends with one line: the task file path or item identifier.
